prayerExcerpt.en-US: May we earnestly devote ourselves to winning our brothers and sisters for Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Nos apliquemos com todo empenho em conquistar irmãos e irmãs para Cristo.

meta.face: A stocky, clean-shaven Spaniard of about forty-five with a large, round, fleshy face and a warm olive-dark complexion — a short, broad nose, full cheeks, dark, rather small, penetrating eyes under thick, straight, black brows, a full lower lip and a rounded, heavy chin; short black hair receding at the temples under the zucchetto; a serious, energetic, kindly gaze to one side.
meta.basis: Photographs of him as archbishop (1860s) show a heavy, round, clean-shaven face with thick dark brows, dark eyes and short receding hair, in cassock, mozzetta and pectoral cross. Santiago de Cuba, his see from 1850 to 1857, is the setting.
